$description: SYNAPSE Chromatic — agent identity registry (FROZEN, INV-CLR-012). One earned hue per agent: nominal data on the OKLCH Hue axis. Lightness is staggered across the 8 (both themes) so they stay distinct under color-vision-deficiency simulation (INV-CLR-005) — equal-lightness categorical palettes collapse under CVD. dark = bright variant for dark canvas; light = deep variant for light canvas. Changing any hue requires a version bump + ADR supersede note.

routing_navigator.$description: Paths / movement — azure (the colour of maps).

pricing_oracle.$description: Economic value — deep blue-violet (v2.0.0, ADR-048: re-hued off amber-gold under the INV-CLR-012 version-bump clause). Placed in the wide H248..H292 gap with a strongly staggered lightness so it stays >=20 deg and CVD-distinct from routing_navigator (azure H248) and demand_prophet (indigo-violet H292).
